name: Tomato & spinach pasta
description: A quick, bright pasta tossed with tender spinach and a simple tomato and olive oil sauce.
instructions: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the penne until just tender, then reserve a little pasta water and drain.
Warm olive oil in a skillet. Add crushed tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the spinach and cook until wilted. Season to taste.
Toss the pasta with the sauce, adding a splash of pasta water if needed. Finish with Parmesan or herbs if you have them.

name: Cheesy spinach omelet
description: Soft eggs folded around melted cheddar and fresh baby spinach. A simple breakfast or light supper.
instructions: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Warm a little oil or butter in a nonstick skillet. Add the spinach and cook until just wilted.
Pour in the eggs. Gently draw the cooked edges toward the center while tilting the pan to let uncooked egg flow underneath.
When nearly set, add cheddar to one half. Fold the omelet over the cheese and cook briefly until melted.

name: Tomato black bean skillet
description: A hearty one-pan skillet of black beans and tomatoes, gently simmered with olive oil and warm spices.
instructions: Warm olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Add the crushed tomatoes and drained black beans. Stir in cumin or chili powder if available.
Simmer for 12–15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thick and bubbling.
Taste, season, and serve warm. Add rice, toast, or a spoonful of yogurt if desired.

name: Creamy chicken pasta
description: Tender chicken and penne coated in a creamy cheddar sauce for an easy, comforting dinner.
instructions: Cook the penne in salted water until tender. Reserve a little pasta water, then drain.
Cook the chicken in a lightly oiled skillet until browned and fully cooked through. Slice or dice it.
Lower the heat. Add milk and grated cheddar, stirring until the cheese melts into a smooth sauce.
Fold in the pasta and chicken. Loosen with pasta water if needed, then season and serve.

name: Pea & cheese pasta
description: A quick, creamy pasta with sweet peas, cheddar, and a little olive oil.
instructions: Boil the penne in salted water. Add the frozen peas for the final 3 minutes of cooking.
Reserve a mug of pasta water, then drain the pasta and peas.
Return them to the warm pot. Stir in olive oil and grated cheddar with a splash of pasta water until glossy.
Season with black pepper and serve while warm.

name: Spinach egg bake
description: A savory baked egg casserole with wilted spinach, milk, and melted cheddar.
instructions: Heat the oven to 190°C / 375°F and lightly oil a small baking dish.
Wilt the spinach in a skillet, then spread it in the baking dish.
Whisk eggs with a splash of milk, salt, and pepper. Pour over the spinach and scatter cheddar on top.
Bake for 18–22 minutes, until the center is set. Rest for 5 minutes before serving.
